$schema: Single source of truth for resume template metadata — read by both frontend/components/ResumeTemplates.tsx and backend/routers/export.py. Do not maintain a second hand-written copy of this list on either side.

templates.name: Modern
templates.atsNotes: Two-column sidebar layout — readable by modern ATS parsers, but a small minority of older parsers can misorder sidebar content.

templates.name: Professional
templates.atsNotes: Single-column, no graphics — the safest layout for strict ATS parsers.

templates.name: Minimal
templates.atsNotes: Single-column, minimal styling — parses cleanly in any ATS.

templates.name: Creative
templates.atsNotes: Gradient header and multi-column skill bars are the most visually distinctive of the five, and the ones most likely to trip up a strict legacy ATS parser.

templates.name: Executive
templates.atsNotes: Two-column with a dark header — typically hand-reviewed for senior roles, but still ATS-parseable.

templates.name: Tech Stack
templates.description: Skills-forward layout for engineers and developers, with categorized technical skills
templates.atsNotes: Single-column, plain text throughout — no skill bars, ratings, or icons standing in for text.

templates.name: Career Starter
templates.description: Confident, adaptive layout for first resumes — promotes Education and Projects when there's no work experience yet
templates.atsNotes: Single-column, adaptive section order — never shows an empty Experience section.

templates.name: Academic
templates.description: Formal CV structure for research and academic careers, built for long multi-page content
templates.atsNotes: Single-column, serif, formal academic headings. Publications/references beyond the standard resume fields aren't fabricated — see docs for the exact section mapping.

templates.name: Healthcare Pro
templates.description: Clean, trustworthy clinical CV with elevated Licenses & Certifications hierarchy
templates.atsNotes: Single-column; credentials get a bordered text treatment, never a graphic or icon.

templates.name: Global Professional
templates.description: Clean, conservative, universally ATS-safe format for global applications
templates.atsNotes: Single-column, neutral. Never renders a photo, date of birth, gender, marital status, religion, or nationality — those fields don't exist on the resume data model.
